messages:
pagerbot: PagerDuty triggered P-1709: service="inference-gateway" signal=5xx_rate_spike (threshold breached) — paging oncall. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx

alex: acked and taking it (oncall). starting triage.

maria: seeing a 503/504 burst from eu-west1 frontends, looks concentrated on auth-proxy upstream timeouts.

alex: confirmed. dashboard shows error_rate spike from 08:12 -> 08:16 UTC, peaking at 8.4%. Request IDs show upstream timeout 504s hitting auth service.

chris: any direct customer impact? any sessions failing?

alex: initial customer-impact check: some requests retried in product, small fraction of API calls failing (internal metrics). not systemic data loss. paging CS for heads-up.

ops-bot: quick-search results: top 3 hosts by 5xx count: gw-eu-01 (42%), gw-eu-02 (31%), gw-eu-03 (12%). Upstream latency to auth-proxy avg=1.9s -> spikes 6-12s.

maria: logs excerpt (tail):
```
2026-03-17T08:13:04Z auth-proxy gw-eu-01 upstream_timeout id=abc123 path=/v1/generate status=504 rt=12036ms
2026-03-17T08:13:17Z auth-proxy gw-eu-02 upstream_error id=def456 tok=err_conn_reset
```

alex: running mitigation: scaling auth-proxy deployment in eu: `kubectl -n prod scale deploy/auth-proxy --replicas=6`

maria: doing a staggered restart on gw-eu-02 to clear sticky connections. also enabling short-circuit fallback (reduce retries) in routing config.

ops-bot: traffic-split job: shifting 25% EU traffic -> us-west for 10m window (gradual). command executed.

pagerbot: PagerDuty update: P-1709 acknowledged by alex; no escalation yet.

sam: @alex @maria CS notified top-2 affected customers, they're seeing slower responses but functional. No immediate exec escalation.

alex: error rate trending down: 5% -> 1.2% in the last 6m. still monitoring.

maria: auth-proxy pod cpu spiked; scaling seems to help. will patch upstream keepalive logic in next release. adding temporary metric alert for upstream latency > 2s.

chris: thanks. can you add a short blameless follow-up note with timeline and RCA pointers when stabilized?

alex: handing to maria for post-incident writeup. I'll start the oncall handoff in 30m.

maria: taking postmortem. incident will be documented: cause=upstream auth-proxy overload + sticky long-lived connections; mitigations=scale + restart + traffic reroute; followups=keepalive fix, autoscale tuning.

pagerbot: PagerDuty: incident P-1709 resolved by alex at 1791010288.

alex: resolving here, leaving runbook updates and links in the ticket. :white_check_mark:

sam: CS confirms customers cleared. closing comms.

maria: filing ticket: INC-2026-331 in tracker and assigning to eng-infra for fix.
